The architecture

One objective in. Your entire function, moving.

Talk to Us

Lyzr sits at the centre. It reads every signal, activates the right agents, runs across every channel and closes every loop back to your goal.

What does your operation actually need?

The right question changes everything.

Most agencies have deployed chatbots or RPA. The Lyzr Government OS starts with why those deployments haven’t reduced the backlog, improved citizen satisfaction, or freed civil servants from paperwork.

A citizen navigates 4.2 agencies, 11 forms and waits 47 days for benefits.

The Government OS orchestrates the citizen journey across agencies verifying eligibility, retrieving verified data, coordinating approvals without requiring citizens to restart at every agency boundary.

How many procurement requests are genuinely complex?

The Government OS handles standard procurement intake, bid analysis, compliance validation, and evaluation summaries routing only genuinely complex procurements to human decision-makers with a full analysis brief.

Demand for services is growing faster than headcount.

The Government OS deploys agents across high-volume rule-bound workflows intake, document validation, eligibility checking, routing reducing manual touchpoints per case without removing human judgment.

Does your compliance posture reflect every requirement right now?

The Government OS monitors regulatory and legislative change feeds continuously mapping each change to current policies, identifying gaps, and generating updated compliance documentation before the next audit cycle.

From objective to outcome

Transforming government operations with AI

Salesforce Government Cloud, ServiceNow, Oracle, SAP, your benefits platform, your procurement system connect what you have. Nothing migrates. Citizen data stays in your sovereign environment. Air-gapped deployment available.

Zero rip-and-replace — the intelligence layer that makes every system across your agency stack work toward your mission objectives.

Not a process automation. A mission goal: reduce benefits processing time from 47 days to 7. Achieve 90% first-contact resolution on citizen queries. The OS returns a ranked execution plan with reasoning attached.

Mission-first. Governed by design. Audit functions get the trail they require.

From 400+ agents, the OS calls what’s relevant: citizen query resolution, benefits processing, procurement validation, compliance monitoring, case management, all under one control plane with human oversight at every sensitive decision.

400+ agents · Cross-agency coordination. Agents pause for human authorisation on every decision affecting citizen rights.

Citizens get answers. Benefits get processed. Procurements get completed. The OS tracks every outcome against your mission objective and the patterns that signal systemic issues.

Every output loops back. The OS builds institutional knowledge that stays in the system.

The question you’re already asking

Your data. Your agents. Your call. Always.

Sovereign, governed and model-agnostic by design, so every agent and every workflow stays yours.

  • Stays in your environment

    Lyzr deploys in your cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP, or on-premise. No data leaves. No training on your proprietary information. 80% of enterprise deployments choose private cloud.

  • Governed at every step

    Every agent action is logged. Every output validated. Human-in-the-loop controls for every decision that matters. SOC 2 Type II. GDPR-ready. EU AI Act compliant path.

  • No lock-in. Ever.

    What you build on Lyzr belongs to you. Walk away with every agent, every workflow, every intelligence layer fully intact. We are the infrastructure, not the owner of what you create on it.

  • Any model. Any framework.

    OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-source. LangChain, CrewAI, Agentforce. Lyzr runs them all under one control plane. You’re never dependent on one provider’s roadmap.
